CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bootstrap_first_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where role = 'owner') then
    insert into public.user_roles (user_id, role) values (new.id, 'owner')
    on conflict do nothing;
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
functionDefinitions.name: bootstrap_first_owner

functionDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.deny_lead_event_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lead_events is append-only';
END;
$function$
functionDefinitions.name: deny_lead_event_mutation

functionDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_role(_user_id uuid, _role app_role)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where user_id = _user_id and role = _role)
$function$
functionDefinitions.name: has_role

functionDefinitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_staff(_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.user_roles where user_id = _user_id and role in ('owner','staff'))
$function$
functionDefinitions.name: is_staff
